events.title: FAKE ME is at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here! Play the free FAKE ME demo with your friends from October 19–26. Create your own disguise using in-game 3D modeling and painting tools, or play as a Seeker and try to find the objects made by other players. After playing, let us know what you think and tell us about any issues you encounter. You can also join our Discord server to meet other players, share your creations, and give us feedback directly! Play the free demo Join our Discord server

events.title: FAKE ME Demo Update
events.summary: Thank you to everyone playing the demo and sharing feedback! We’re reviewing the issues you report and continuing to update the game. Here’s what changed in the latest update:Added a search bar to the lobby browser.Updated the leaderboard interface.Reduced Faker movement speed to improve game balance.Improved bullet hit detection.Drag selection now also selects objects and model faces behind other objects.Removed the range limit from Seeker skills.Fixed several reported bugs.Please keep telling

events.title: FAKE ME Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: Play online hide-and-seek with your friends. Get creative when you hide, and keep an eye on anything suspicious when you seek. The demo lets you try two different ways to hide:Model and Hide: Create the object you’ll hide as from scratch using in-game 3D modeling and painting tools.Prop Paint: Transform into an object on the map and paint it however you like. events.title: NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER
events.summary: Our new gameplay trailer is here! Take a closer look at some of the features coming to FAKE ME, including model saving, model library & exporting, custom voice recording, and Only Paint Mode. SAVE, VIEW & EXPORT YOUR MODELSYour creations won’t have to disappear when a round ends! Save the models you create to your model library and revisit them whenever you want. You will also be able to take screenshots of your designs or export your models to other programs, allowing you to share your creation
